limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the counter’s advance condition but also made `ready_a` high during reset and gated `valid_b` with `valid_a`, changing two behaviors the reference fix preserves.

The test exercised stalls after five accepted bits but expected the rewrite’s low `valid_b` during those stalls and high `ready_a` during reset, so it passed without detecting either timing regression.
Deleting and recreating the module was unnecessary for a fix that only required changing one operator in the counter’s hold condition.
